messages.text: Hi, I sent back the blue mug from my last order because it arrived chipped. Can I get a refund?

tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"refund returned item that arrived chipped; eligibility and whether a person must review/handle damaged item returns"}

messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/return", "title": "Items must be returned first", "text": "The shop refunds only units it has received back, as shown by its own return records, never by a statement of the customer or the assistant. If the records show the units arrived, the request continues normally. If they do not, the shop pays nothing for those units; if the customer says the units were already sent, a staff member checks."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/exceptions", "title": "Exceptions and talking to a person", "text": "Anything this policy does not cover, and any request for an exception, goes to a staff member. The customer can ask for a person at any time."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/window", "title": "Time limit", "text": "A refund must be requested no later than 30 days after the delivery time recorded on the order. Days are exact periods of twenty-four hours, and a request at exactly the deadline is on time. The request time is the moment the shop creates the refund proposal. If an earlier proposal for the same items was created in time but expired or stopped being valid before it was paid, a later request is not refused for being late: a staff member takes the case."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}

tool_calls.name: propose_refund
tool_calls.arguments: {"order_id":"d01-o1","unit_ids":["d01-o1-u1"],"summary_for_staff":"Customer says the blue ceramic mug arrived chipped and was returned."}

messages.content: {"ok": true, "proposal_id": "prop-25ba44514f824a2c", "status": "awaiting_customer_confirmation", "outcome": "eligible", "amount_minor": 4990, "currency": "BRL", "policy_citations": [], "next_step": "Tell the customer the amount. They confirm with the button on the proposal card; a typed yes is not a confirmation."}

messages.text: The blue mug is recorded as returned, and your refund proposal is eligible for **R$49.90**. Please confirm it using the button on the proposal card; replying “yes” here won’t confirm it. After you confirm, a staff member will review the request.
